_comment: Copy to config.json (or set ARTEX_CONFIG to another path). This file only has database and skill_dir. LLM and the other settings come from environment variables or in-app settings, not this file.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Precedence: environment variable ARTEX_PG_DSN > this file's database. Use one of the two forms: (A) fill in the fields below; (B) set only database.dsn to one full connection string.
_comment_database_dsn: Form (B): delete the database object above and use a full DSN instead. When dsn is non-empty, the separate fields are ignored.
_comment_skill_dir: Skill root (one skill per subdirectory, including SKILL.md). Precedence: environment variable ARTEX_SKILL_DIR > this field > default (skills/ next to the executable). Leave this field empty or delete it to use the default. Relative paths are resolved against the current working directory.
